findings.body: The workflow uses incorrect Bash syntax for array assignment: `force_args=($RELEASE_FORCE)` and `force_args+=(-Force -Confirm)`. This will cause a runtime error when the script tries to execute, preventing `-Force -Confirm` arguments from being passed to PowerShell. Correct usage should be `force_args+=(...)` or proper quoting/iteration of arguments.

The test previously asserted that the rejected response would have status `409` (Conflict). However, according to documentation and the assertion on line 391 (`expect([downloadA.status, downloadB.status].sort()).toEqual([200, 428])`), the correct status for a rejected download should be `428` (Precondition Required) as per RFC 6585. This change fixes test assertions to use `428` and makes the test more robust against race conditions by checking both possible response orderings.
